map.输入选址区域人流量、竞争密度等参数，评估便利店选址可行性: Enter the foot traffic, competitor density and other parameters of a candidate area to assess the feasibility of a convenience-store site
map.📖 查看「选址（评估/竞争/目标）模型使用指南」: 📖 View the "Site Selection Assessment Model Guide"
map.按人流量、竞争密度、常住人口、租金、可见性五维加权评分输出综合分与选址等级（A/: A weighted score over five dimensions — foot traffic, competitor density, resident population, rent and visibility — yields an overall score and a site grade (A/B/C); the model quantifies site-selection factors and the result is a reference for outlet-layout decisions, while final profitability still depends on product mix and operations.
map.开便利店或门店前，按人流、竞争、人口、租金、面积与可见性六项打分，得到综合选址得: Before opening a convenience store or shop, score foot traffic, competition, population, rent, area and visibility to get an overall site score and recommendation.
map.对多个候选铺位分别评估，按总分排序选出优先洽谈的对象。: Assess several candidate premises separately and rank them by total score to pick the one to negotiate first.
map.已开业门店做复盘时回填参数，验证当年选址判断是否与经营表现一致。: For an already-open store, fill in the parameters in a review to check whether the original site decision matches its actual performance.
map.A 铺：人流 8000、竞争 2 家、人口 3 万、租金 120 元/m²、可见: Premise A: traffic 8000, 2 competitors, population 30,000, rent ¥120/m², visibility 8 → overall about 82 (excellent); Premise B: traffic 3000, 5 competitors, population 10,000, rent ¥200/m², visibility 5 → about 48 (fair); with limited resources, negotiate Premise A first.
map.高租金被其他维度抵消: High rent offset by other dimensions
map.某铺租金 260 元/m²（得分较低），但人流、人口与可见性均接近满分，综合仍达: A premise rents at ¥260/m² (a low score) yet its traffic, population and visibility are near full marks, so the overall still reaches 70; this shows high rent can be partly offset by strong footfall and should not be the sole reason to reject a site.
map.页面内置经验权重：人流 30%、竞争 20%、人口 20%、租金 15%、可见性: The page uses built-in empirical weights: traffic 30%, competition 20%, population 20%, rent 15% and visibility 15%; use them to judge the emphasis for a different business type, and adjust according to your own operating experience.
map.综合 ≥75 为优秀（强烈推荐）、60–74 良好、45–59 一般需谨慎、<4: An overall ≥75 is excellent (strongly recommended), 60-74 good, 45-59 fair and requiring caution, and <45 not recommended; the bands are for cross-comparison only.
map.竞争店数越多得分越低？: Do more competing stores lower the score?
map.是。竞争对手每增加 1 家该项扣约 15 分，最低 0 分；但适度竞争也可能代表: Yes. Each additional competitor deducts about 15 points on that item down to a minimum of 0; but moderate competition can also indicate a mature trade area, so read it together with traffic and population.
map.日均人流量是便利店选址最关键指标，建议≥5000人/天: Average daily foot traffic is the most critical indicator for convenience-store siting; ≥5000 people/day is recommended
map.500m内竞争店超过5家会显著分流客流: More than 5 competing stores within 500 m significantly siphons off foot traffic
map.周边常住人口≥3000人可支撑一家便利店运营: A nearby resident population of ≥3000 can support one convenience store
map.租金占比应低于预估营业额的15%: Rent should stay below 15% of the estimated turnover
map.可见性包括门头宽度和行人视角可见程度: Visibility covers storefront width and how visible it is from a pedestrian's line of sight
map.便利店选址评估工具，从人流量、竞争密度、人口、租金、可见性五个维度综合评分，判定: A convenience-store site assessment tool that scores foot traffic, competitor density, population, rent and visibility across five dimensions to judge site feasibility.
map.如何使用选址（评估/竞争/目标）模型: How to use the Site Selection Assessment Model
map.便利店新开网点选址打分、多候选点位横向对比、租金与客流匹配度敏感性分析。: Scoring a new convenience-store location, side-by-side comparison of multiple candidate sites, and sensitivity analysis of the match between rent and footfall.
map.便利店选址评估器，输入人流量、竞争密度等参数评估选址可行性，辅助网点布局决策。: A convenience-store site assessor: enter parameters such as foot traffic and competitor density to assess site feasibility and support outlet-layout decisions.
map.便利店选址评估、商铺投资研判、零售网点规划等需要量化打分的场景。: Scenarios needing quantitative scoring, such as convenience-store site assessment, shop-investment appraisal and retail outlet planning.
map.按人流量、竞争密度、常住人口、租金、可见性、店铺面积六维加权评分输出综合分与选址: Scores the site on six weighted dimensions — foot traffic, competition, population, rent, visibility and shop area — and outputs an overall score plus a grade (Excellent / Good / Fair / Poor). The model quantifies site factors as a reference for network planning; profitability still depends on assortment and operations.
map.怎么用这个选址评估模型: How to use this site evaluation model
map.面积为什么也参与评分？: Why does shop area affect the score?
map.输入超出有效区间时按端点夹取：人流 0–10000 人/天、竞争 0–20 家、: Out-of-range inputs are clamped to the valid bounds: foot traffic 0–10,000 people/day, competitors 0–20, population 0–50,000, rent 0–1,000 CNY/m², area 0–10,000 m², visibility 0–10 points.
map.页面内置经验权重：人流 28%、竞争 18%、人口 18%、租金 13%、可见性: Built-in empirical weights: foot traffic 28%, competition 18%, population 18%, rent 13%, visibility 13%, area fit 10%; use them to judge emphasis for different formats, and adjust based on your own operating experience.
map.选址评分 = 人流 × 0.28 + 竞争 × 0.18 + 人口 × 0.18: Site score = traffic × 0.28 + competition × 0.18 + population × 0.18 + rent × 0.13 + visibility × 0.13 + area × 0.10; traffic = min(100, daily footfall ÷ 100), competition = max(0, 100 − competitors × 15), rent scores 100/80/60/40 at ≤100/150/200/300 CNY, and area scores 100 within 40–120 m², losing 1.5 points per m² below and 0.5 per m² above.
map.A 铺：人流 8000、竞争 2 家、人口 3 万、租金 120 元/m²、可见: Site A: traffic 8,000, 2 competitors, population 30,000, rent 120 CNY/m², visibility 8, area 80 m² → 83.8 (excellent); Site B: traffic 3,000, 5 competitors, population 10,000, rent 200 CNY/m², visibility 5, area 80 m² → 55.2 (average); with limited resources, negotiate Site A first.
map.某铺租金 260 元/m²（该项仅 20 分），但人流、人口、竞争、可见性与面积: A site at 260 CNY/m² (only 20 points on that item) still scores 89.6 overall because traffic, population, competition, visibility and area are all near perfect; high rent can be partly offset by strong footfall and should not be the sole reason to reject a site.
map.填写日均人流量、500m 内竞争店数、周边常住人口、月租金（元/㎡）、店铺面积（: Enter average daily foot traffic, competing stores within 500 m, nearby resident population, monthly rent (CNY/m²) and shop area (m²), then rate visibility subjectively from 1 to 10.
map.点击「计算」得到六项分项得分与加权综合分。: Click Calculate to get the six sub-scores and the weighted total.
map.对照评级（优秀 ≥75、良好 ≥60、一般 ≥45、不佳 <45）横向比较多个候: Compare ratings (excellent ≥75, good ≥60, average ≥45, poor <45) across candidate sites and copy the report in one click.
map.日均人流量：10000 人/天 ≈ 人流项满分: Average daily foot traffic: 10,000 people/day ≈ full marks on traffic
map.竞争店数：500m 内同类门店，每多 1 家约扣 15 分: Competing stores: similar shops within 500 m; each extra store costs about 15 points
map.常住人口：5000 人 ≈ 人口项满分: Resident population: 5,000 people ≈ full marks on population
map.店铺面积：40–120㎡ 记满分，过小或过大按差额扣分: Shop area: full marks for 40–120 m²; smaller or larger spaces lose points by the gap
map.把人流量、竞争密度、常住人口、租金、可见性与面积六项分别折算成 0–100 分，: Convert traffic, competition density, resident population, rent, visibility and area into 0–100 scores, then weight them 28/18/18/13/13/10 to get the total and rating.
map.便利店常用面积为 40–120㎡：过小难以陈列与周转，过大则租金压力上升，因此落: Convenience stores typically use 40–120 m²: too small to display and turn stock, too large raises rent pressure, so this range gets full marks; below it loses 1.5 points per m² and above it 0.5 per m².
map.本工具在本地浏览器实时计算，不依赖服务器；权重与阈值属经验模型，结果仅供参考，最: This tool computes locally in your browser without a server; the weights and thresholds are an empirical model for reference only, and final decisions should combine site visits and lease terms.
